map.不同清洁剂稀释比例一样吗？: Is the dilution ratio the same for different cleaners?
map.不一样，必须按产品标签或 MSDS 执行；强酸、强碱、含氯消毒剂各有安全浓度，混: No, they differ; follow the product label or MSDS. Strong acids, strong alkalis and chlorine-based disinfectants each have safe concentrations, so read the ingredients before mixing.
map.酸性清洁剂和含氯清洁剂能混用吗？: Can acidic and chlorine-based cleaners be mixed?
map.严禁混用。酸性剂与氯系（如 84）混合会释放氯气，可致中毒；应分开使用并间隔冲洗: Mixing is strictly forbidden. An acidic agent mixed with a chlorine product (such as 84) releases chlorine gas and can cause poisoning; use them separately and rinse in between.
map.浓度越高清洁力越强吗？: Does a higher concentration always clean better?
map.否。过高浓度易腐蚀表面、残留刺激皮肤，且浪费；按标签推荐倍数即可，顽固污渍应增加: No. Too high a concentration easily corrodes surfaces, leaves irritating residue and wastes product; follow the label dilution. For stubborn stains, increase contact time rather than raising concentration blindly.
